title: Return Attribution Engine (Barra-style Decomposition)
description: Implement AttributionEngine for Barra-style factor model return attribution, decomposing portfolio returns into factor exposure and residual components. Support single-factor (P2) and multi-factor (future) attribution.

criteria: AttributionEngine computes factor and residual decomposition: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_attribution_engine.py -p no:asyncio (exit code 0)
R-squared indicates model fit: verify by assertion in tests
Factor exposure computed correctly: verify by known-input test
Frozen AttributionResult returned: verify by frozen dataclass test
convergence.definition_of_done: AttributionEngine correctly decomposes returns into factor and residual components with R-squared

files.change: AttributionEngine class with compute() method for Barra-style decomposition
Unit tests for AttributionEngine: decomposition correctness, R-squared, edge cases

implementation.title: Implement AttributionEngine class
implementation.description: Create synapse/backtest/attribution.py with AttributionEngine class. compute() takes portfolio_returns (pd.Series), factor_returns (pd.DataFrame columns=factor_ids), and factor_exposures (pd.DataFrame). Uses OLS regression: R_portfolio = sum(beta_k * F_k) + epsilon. Returns frozen AttributionResult with factor_returns dict, residual_returns tuple, total_factor_return, residual_return, r_squared. For single-factor P2: beta is approximately 1.0 for Q5 and -1.0 for Q1 (by construction).
modification_points: Implement compute() method: OLS regression of portfolio returns on factor returns
Compute factor_exposure_return = beta * factor_return for each factor
logic_flow: Align portfolio_returns and factor_returns on common dates
Compute factor loadings via OLS: np.linalg.lstsq(factor_returns, portfolio_returns)
Compute r_squared from explained vs total variance
Return frozen AttributionResult with all components

implementation.title: Write unit tests for AttributionEngine
implementation.description: Create tests/unit/test_attribution_engine.py with 6+ test cases: decomposition correctness (factor + residual = total), R-squared computation, single-factor attribution, edge cases (empty returns, zero factor returns), frozen dataclass.
modification_points: Test factor + residual = total return (within tolerance)
Test R-squared computation with known variance
Test single-factor attribution matches expected beta
Test edge case: empty returns -> all zeros
Test edge case: zero factor returns -> R-squared = 0
logic_flow: Create synthetic portfolio and factor returns with known relationship
Verify attribution decomposition: factor_contribution + residual = total
Test edge cases produce safe defaults
